task_description = (
    "Please research and determine the minimum number of page links a person must click on "
    "to navigate from the English Wikipedia page on 'The Lord of the Rings (the book)' to the English "
    "Wikipedia page on 'A Song of Ice and Fire (the book series)'. Only count direct page-link clicks in a valid navigation path. "
    "The pages should be considered as they appeared at the end of the day on July 3, 2023. "
    "Please provide the number of clicks required as well as, if available, a brief explanation of the navigation path with the sequence of pages. "
    "It is critical that the answer is correct and fully verified against that snapshot date."
)
search_agent(task=task_description)
